fnol_description: Toilet supply line burst in the upstairs bathroom.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Supply line nut cracked; water ran about 40 minutes before the insured shut it off. Bathroom floor and the dining room ceiling below are damaged.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: bathroom floor $2,300, dining room ceiling $1,700, paint $600.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under NG-1101 WE-1 as a sudden escape of water. Covered loss $4,600, less the $1,000 deductible, net payable $3,600.

fnol_description: Water damage in the kitchen from under the sink.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Plumber found the drain trap joint leaking slowly. The cabinet base has rotted; plumber estimates the leak ran for about three weeks.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Insured confirms a musty smell under the sink for several weeks.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied. The escape continued for 10 days or more before discovery, so it is seepage under exclusion E-41. Deductible $500 not applied as nothing is payable.

fnol_description: Mold found after a washing machine leak.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Washer hose failed on 2026-03-02 and was found the same day. Insured was travelling and left the carpet wet for a week; no drying was started.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Mold confirmed in the carpet pad and lower drywall. Water damage estimate $2,800; mold remediation estimate $4,500.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: water damage covered under WE-1, $2,800 less $1,000 deductible = $1,800 payable. Mold remediation of $4,500 denied under E-63 because drying did not begin within 72 hours.

fnol_description: Roof damage from the hurricane.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Hurricane Delia, named by the National Hurricane Center on 2026-08-20, crossed the area on 2026-08-23. Shingles and flashing lost on the west slope. No water inside.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Roof repair estimate $13,200.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under NG-1102. The hurricane deductible of 2% of the $300,000 Coverage A limit, $6,000, applies instead of the $1,000 all-peril deductible. Net payable $7,200.

fnol_description: Rain came into the living room during a storm.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: First call: insured says the wind blew the living room window in.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Inspection: all windows intact. Rain came in through a window that had been left open and around worn chimney flashing. No opening was made by the wind.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-52, rain entering without a storm-made opening. Interior damage estimate was $3,900. All-peril deductible on the policy is $1,000.

fnol_description: Watch lost on a business trip.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Watch is item 2 on the Valuable Articles Schedule, agreed value $6,200. Lost somewhere in the airport; no theft shown.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under VA-1 and VA-2 (loss anywhere, including unexplained disappearance). Paid at the agreed value of $6,200. Deductible $0 because no deductible applies to scheduled articles.

fnol_description: Gold bracelet missing after a party at home.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Gold bracelet, not on the schedule, value $2,100. No sign of a break-in; insured is not sure whether it was lost or taken.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-73. The bracelet is not scheduled and theft has not been shown. The VA-3 theft sublimit does not apply. Deductible on file $500.

fnol_description: Water from a cracked pipe in the basement.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Copper pipe in the basement cracked; about 3 cm of water on the floor.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Cleanup contractor extracted the water. Estimate $6,900 for cleanup, flooring and drywall.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Insured mentions a small earthquake (magnitude 3.9) the night before the pipe cracked.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Engineer's report: the crack was caused by the foundation shifting during the earthquake.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under NG-1105 E-83, water escape caused by earth movement. Deductible on the policy is $1,500.

fnol_description: Frozen pipe burst in the lake house.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: The lake house has been empty since 2025-11-20, 53 days before the loss. Thermostat was switched off and the water was not drained.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-44, freezing while the dwelling was unoccupied for more than 30 days with no heat and the system not drained. Damage estimate was $12,300; deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Pipe froze and burst inside the garage wall.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Insured was living in the home throughout. Cold snap; house heated, garage unheated. Pipe in the garage wall split.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: opening and restoring the garage wall plus water damage $2,900; pipe repair $450.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under WE-1 and WE-2. The $450 pipe repair is excluded under E-45 (the part that failed). Covered $2,900 less $1,000 deductible = $1,900 payable.

fnol_description: Radiator leak in the home office damaged equipment.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Radiator valve failed suddenly. Insured is employed by an accounting firm and works from home. The damaged laptop ($1,900) belongs to the employer.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Insured's own printer, used for work, also damaged: $1,300.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: employer's laptop denied under NG-1106 E-93 (property of others). Printer covered under HB-1: $1,300 less $500 deductible = $800 payable.

fnol_description: Kitchen fire destroyed candle stock and a sewing machine.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Fire started at the stove. Insured sells handmade candles online. Candle stock worth $3,000 destroyed, plus a sewing machine used for the business worth $1,800.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: candle stock denied under E-91 (stock held for sale). Sewing machine covered under HB-1: $1,800 less $1,000 deductible = $800 payable.

fnol_description: Mold in the basement.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: The home inspection report from the purchase, dated 2025-10-04, already notes mold in the north-west basement corner. Policy started 2026-01-01.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under NG-1103 E-62, mold that existed before the policy. Remediation quote was $5,600. Deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Water in the basement after a storm.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Water seeping in through cracks in the basement walls after three days of rain. Water table is high; no surface water entered the house and no pipes failed.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-46, groundwater seeping through the foundation. This is not E-42 surface water. Estimate was $7,400; deductible $2,500.

fnol_description: Tree fell in the yard during a windstorm.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: An oak fell across the back lawn. It did not hit the house, fence, shed or any other structure.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Tree removal quote $1,400.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-54, tree removal where no covered structure was damaged. Deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Windstorm damaged the roof.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Asphalt roof installed in 2008, so 18 years old on the date of loss. Replacement cost of the roof surface $12,000; actual cash value $5,200. Gutters damaged: $600.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered. Roof surface paid at actual cash value under WH-3 ($5,200) plus gutters ($600) = $5,800, less $1,000 deductible = $4,800 payable.

fnol_description: Water heater burst.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Water heater tank split in the utility room.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Water spread to the hallway carpet. Drying contractor on site the same day.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: carpet $2,200, drywall $900, new water heater $1,450.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Insured asked whether the water heater itself is covered. Explained E-45.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: carpet and drywall covered under WE-1, $3,100 less $1,000 deductible = $2,100 payable. Water heater $1,450 denied under E-45 (the part that failed).

fnol_description: Cracks in the living room walls.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Insured believes a delivery truck reversed into the front wall and caused the cracks.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: No impact marks on the outside wall. Engineer: hairline cracks and a sticking door are normal settling of a 1970s house. No recent earthquake.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-82, settling and cracking. Repair quote $3,300; deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Kitchen fire after an earthquake.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: A magnitude 5.1 earthquake knocked the gas range loose and a fire started in the kitchen. Cracks in the garage slab from the quake itself.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Fire damage estimate $18,400. Garage slab crack repair $2,600.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: fire damage covered under GM-2 (fire after earth movement), $18,400 less $1,000 deductible = $17,400 payable. Garage slab $2,600 denied under E-81, earth movement.

fnol_description: Sump pump failed and the basement took on water.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Heavy rain. The sump pump motor burned out and water backed up through the sump pit into the finished basement.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-43, sewer and drain backup, which includes backup through a sump pump. The pump is not a household appliance escape under WE-1. Estimate $8,100; deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Hurricane flooded the ground floor.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Hurricane Emil, named by the National Hurricane Center. Sea water surged about 60 cm into the ground floor: $41,000. Minor wind damage to the roof: $2,000.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: storm surge damage of $41,000 denied under E-53. Roof wind damage of $2,000 is covered but is below the hurricane deductible of $10,000 (2% of the $500,000 Coverage A limit), so net payable is $0.

fnol_description: Painting damaged when it fell off the wall.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Oil painting, item 4 on the Valuable Articles Schedule, agreed value $9,000. It fell while being dusted and the canvas tore.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Conservator's repair quote $2,300. Canvas is not a fragile article under E-72.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under VA-1, repair cost $2,300 paid in full. Deductible $0, as no deductible applies to scheduled articles.

fnol_description: Crystal vase broken.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Crystal vase, item 5 on the Valuable Articles Schedule, agreed value $3,400. The insured's dog knocked it off a table.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-72, breakage of a fragile article not caused by fire, theft or collapse of the building. Deductible $0 for scheduled articles, but nothing is payable.

fnol_description: Leak from the upstairs bathroom into the kitchen.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Upstairs bathroom leak found by the insured in the evening.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Plumber: shower valve cartridge failed; water fell through to the kitchen ceiling.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Drying equipment set up within 24 hours of discovery.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Mold found in the kitchen ceiling cavity during tear-out.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: water damage $3,600; mold remediation $9,900.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: water damage covered under WE-1, $3,600 less $1,000 deductible = $2,600. Mold covered under MR-1 but capped at the MR-2 sublimit of $7,500. Total payable $10,100.

fnol_description: Ceiling leak in the bedroom.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Water stain and drip in the main bedroom ceiling.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: First view: probably the air conditioning condensate line in the attic, which would be a covered escape under WE-1.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate $2,700 for ceiling and insulation.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Roofer's report: the AC line is dry and intact. Rain is entering through worn flashing around the vent stack. No storm damage to the roof.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under NG-1102 E-52, rain entering without a storm-made opening. Not an escape of water under NG-1101. Deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Dishwasher leak damaged the kitchen floor.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Dishwasher door seal failed suddenly during a cycle; water spread under the laminate floor. Found within the hour.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: laminate floor $3,300.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under WE-1. $3,300 less $1,000 deductible = $2,300 payable.

fnol_description: Mold on the bathroom ceiling.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Bathroom has no exhaust fan. Mold on the ceiling above the shower from months of steam and condensation. No pipe or fixture leak found.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under NG-1103 E-61, mold caused by condensation and humidity. Not pre-existing (E-62 does not apply). Remediation quote $2,400; deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Camera stolen from the car at a client photo shoot.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Business camera worth $2,200 stolen from the insured's locked car at a client's venue. Police report filed.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under HB-2, business property away from home. $2,200 less $500 deductible = $1,700, capped at the HB-2 sublimit of $500. Payable $500.

fnol_description: Sudden pipe burst in the hallway wall.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Insured reports a sudden burst in the hallway wall.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Plumber: pinhole leak in a corroded copper line. Staining and swelling in the wall show the leak ran for about 12 days before it was found.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-109
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under E-41. The escape continued for 10 days or more, so it is seepage, not a sudden escape. Estimate $4,800; deductible $1,000.

fnol_description: Hail storm damaged the roof and attic.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Asphalt shingle roof, 6 years old. Hail bruised and cracked the shingles; water leaked into the attic.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: roof $9,600; attic insulation $800.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-113
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under NG-1102. E-51 does not apply because the roof is not metal. $10,400 less $1,000 deductible = $9,400 payable.
